shortcut_v4.storage_contract: SQLite state: local WAL or NFS/CIFS DELETE; synchronous FULL; SQLite file locks and BEGIN IMMEDIATE serialize writers; filesystem locking/fsync requires field validation; explicit new generation schema migration

core_route_contract.consumer: existing law_candidates.discover then native current selection/assessment
core_route_contract.multi_turn: current goal revision and accepted route head; old immutable knowledge retained; pending corrections hide old routes
core_route_contract.storage: existing sw_unit/sw_knowledge/sw_member/sw_dependency and append-only trace; no SQL schema migration
core_route_contract.scope: same current task/facts/category plus document ACL and source generation/index

common_catalogue.scope: all authenticated consumers; current document ACL and generation/fulltext binding required
common_catalogue.private_history: existing user/team sessions, facts and native routes remain private
common_catalogue.storage: existing cases-v4.sqlite sw_* relations; no SQL schema change
common_catalogue.projection: one common legal_wiki projection; per-request reads recheck permissions

bounded_recall.producer: published sw_knowledge → enqueue(projection) → extractive card/token projection
bounded_recall.consumer: request_entry or memory-intent existing call selects up to2 source routes; RECALL revalidates originals
bounded_recall.storage: reconstructible sw_recall_card/sw_recall_term; immutable authority unchanged; old release ignores additive tables
bounded_recall.fallback: no candidate, rejected, stale or unavailable: normal discovery
bounded_recall.external: public_only and current source/document scope required; internal CM excluded

ad_management.storage: selected shortcut SQL store; normalized ad_* relations; no Redis
ad_management.worker: durable SQL ad_schedule/ad_job; same wiki compiler; internal model only
ad_management.interpretation: GENOS internal LLM for every active AD turn except exact entry/exit; no legal-agent routing or external fallback
ad_management.context: SQL session/history metadata and bounded previews; read_table/read_context scoped segments; latest segment plus compact notes
ad_management.language_state: ad_language_turn claim and full source context; ad_language_call per-inference input/output/receipt; no write lock during inference
ad_management.output: ad-mode-v1 text Markdown plus escaped table_html; GENOS workflow/chat scroll container; list/detail continuation

genos_operator_paths.consumer: service.py startup plus generation manifest verification
genos_operator_paths.operator_setup: generated by oneclick; no manual environment variables

document_build.raw_selection: Common filename_versions policy before structure; only is_latest internal rows admitted

structure.method: native XML/HTML/HWPX/DOCX/HWP parsers; preserve PDF source parser contracts

document_build.source_merge: document-release prepare; default glossary-corpus-policy=replace; no review execution

connections_index.navigation_audit_generation: retain validated spans and catalogue candidates; replay evidence product; integer legacy origins
connections_index.navigation_audit_storage: lossless-gzip-after-verified-build; transient SQLite restore for offline checks

incremental_append.entrypoint: document-release append --base-generation BASE --delta-generation DELTA --delta-fulltext FTS --output NEW
incremental_append.contract: document-append-v1; compact-v2 source/navigation and unit fulltext; same glossary; disjoint document IDs
incremental_append.policy: Index delta only; copy base rows; reuse glossary assets; resolve only new reference sources; parent-linked audit; no activation

incremental_definitions.contract: naming-definition-append-v1; exact inline naming witness plus existing deterministic reference; unresolved scope; canonical_approval=false
incremental_definitions.policy: Append definition and definition_reference only. Preserve all existing rows, reuse original text/glossary/fulltext; consumers: existing definition lookup and reference tools; no retrieval priority change or activation.
